Help

Choose a die and quantity. The modifier is added once to the total. Press space or R to roll.

After a roll, tap a die or its numbered button to hold it. Held dice stay put while the others roll. Tap again to release.

Save favorite combinations with ☆. Natural 20s, natural 1s, all-highest rolls and all-ones get special effects. Toggle ✦ to switch those effects off.

Results use independent secure randomness. The last 30 rolls, up to 12 favorites, and settings can be saved on this device with your permission.
